# Introduction

Hello, I'm Yifan Wan. I am a second-year MPH student at the Mailman School of Public Health of Columbia University.

## About me

Currently, I am pursuing a Master's degree in Public Health at Columbia University, 
focusing on biostatistics and epidemiology. My research interests lie in 
the application of quantitative research methods in clinical medicine and public health. 
Previously, I have participated in related studies such as individualized intervention strategies 
for chronic diseases and cost-benefit analysis of healthcare interventions, 
and have accumulated certain practical experience in the medical field. 
In the future, I hope to further explore clinical data analysis, disease risk prediction, 
and real-world research, and utilize data-driven methods to provide scientific basis for disease prevention, 
clinical decision-making, and healthcare policies.
